entries.name: The Rotting Gazebo
entries.description: A compact, lopsided octagonal gazebo with a green patinated roof, four visible posts and one empty suspended swing seat. Moss and dry leaves soften the abandoned structure. entries.name: The Croquet Umpire
entries.description: A tall freestanding croquet scoreboard with a stepped crown, chunky wooden number drums and two crossed mallets fixed beneath it. No face or body is attached. It declares every route out of bounds, then secretly changes its own score. Two tiny ghostly applause marks appear whenever it cheats. Intent idea: a predictable count followed by a penalty.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: one drum twitches. Tell: drums align. Action: three drums flip sequentially; a small striped ball rolls through its empty base. Resolve: the first drum quietly changes again. Use one ball sprite.
entries.signature: Signature Vertical sporting score apparatus; no nursery toy creature or repeatedly animated croquet set.

entries.name: The Lost Compass
entries.description: An oversized open pocket compass resting on its rim, a broad oval lid behind a round brass bowl and a long blue needle hovering just above it. entries.name: The Gardener of Rot
entries.description: A spectral estate gardener with a drooping broad hat, patched coat and wooden clogs fading into dry leaves. A mushroom grows from his hatband, never his skin. His blunt planting dibber points downward. Fond of the old maze, he repairs the wrong paths and composts yesterday’s directions. Intent idea: preparation becomes renewal, with a readable interruption opportunity.
